meta.name: tool-calling-tutor
meta.description: Use when a tool-calling agent does not call a tool, sends wrong arguments, loops without stopping, or needs a function schema. Guides a four-branch diagnosis and five-step schema repair. Do not use for framework-specific, MCP-server, or production-observability questions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定位AI不调用工具或卡死循环的根因并修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发AI智能体,且常遇到工具调用出错或卡循环。
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose and fix AI agent tool-calling failures and loops.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build AI agents and often see tool-calling errors or endless loops.

howto.what: 遇到tool calling问题时，Claude先让你选四种症状之一，再按分支给方案：改description、修参数schema、查循环控制或按5步设计schema，并建议先跑mock测试。框架、MCP、监控问题会转走。
howto.when: 当你说工具没被调用、参数传错、循环跑不停，或需要设计函数schema时触发。不处理框架、MCP或生产监控问题。

say.text: 我的LLM一直不调用工具，怎么办？
say.note: 会先让你选症状类型，再定位description或工具边界

say.text: 帮我看看这个函数schema哪里写错了？
ReAct循环停不下来，怎么排查？

howto.what_en: Claude first asks which of four symptoms applies, then guides branch-specific fixes (description, parameter schema, control flow, or 5-step schema design), suggests mock tests, and routes out-of-scope questions away.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a tool-calling agent won't call a tool, sends wrong arguments, loops forever, or needs a function schema. Not for framework, MCP-server, or production-observability questions.

say_en.text: My LLM won't call my tool, what should I do?
say_en.note: Asks which symptom applies, then checks description or boundary.

say_en.text: Can you check why this function schema is wrong?
say_en.note: It will inspect parameter type, required, and enum.

say_en.text: My ReAct loop never stops, how to debug?
say_en.note: It will check messages history and tool_call_id.
